Reference

Glossary

The public term map for Plectis: every active vocabulary row is projected here as an expandable reader card, with its meaning namespace stated explicitly. General or domain usage, externally anchored terms, system-local specializations, system-coined terms, compatibility identifiers, and the project name are not treated as one ontology. These rows are generated from the governed system vocabulary registry.

How to read definitions. Outside explicit Plectis/ai_workflow context, ordinary, disciplinary, and externally owned meanings take precedence. A system-local specialization narrows an existing word only here; a system-coined term makes no claim to be generally accepted terminology. Repeated class-wide boundaries are explained here once; the cards below add only term-specific distinctions. In particular, a paper is the rendered PDF write-up for a project, question, or result, while a paper module is an internal subsystem-orientation packet, not a publication or proof.
Legacy name note. Microcosm is not a current glossary term for Plectis. It appears only in lineage, legacy URLs, compatibility identifiers, old source paths, and migration records. For the rename and old-route behavior, read Lineage & legacy and the legacy route manifest.
plectisPlectispublic_projectionProject identityPlectis is the public name for this project: the site, the reader-facing map, the components and papers it presents, and the public source repository behind them. Its name comes from the Latin plectere, to weave or entwine: it describes the public surface that gathers those separate, source-linked parts into one readable whole.
componentcomponentpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA component is one bounded unit of working machinery with a defined job, explicit inputs and outputs, and a claim limit, called a component in public copy and an organ in source identifiers.
scope_limitscope limitpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA scope limit—also called a claim ceiling or authority ceiling—is the explicit boundary between what a unit's evidence establishes and what the unit is not allowed to assert.

theorytheorypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA theory is an organized body of definitions, assumptions, methods, and results used to explain or reason about a class of phenomena or structures.
tooltoolpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA tool is a program or instrument used to inspect, transform, validate, or operate on artifacts.
toolchaintoolchainpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA toolchain is the ordered set of compilers, interpreters, package managers, builders, and checkers used to turn source files into a runnable or verified result.
totienttotientpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe totient of a whole number is how many smaller positive numbers share no factor with it.
transcripttranscriptpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA transcript is the recorded text of a session, kept so what was said or done can be reread rather than recalled.
trusttrustpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageTrust is a willingness to rely on a person, system, source, or claim under particular expectations and risk.
truth_maintenancetruth maintenancediagnosticSystem-coined termTruth maintenance is the bookkeeping that ties each belief to its evidence, dependencies, invalidation conditions, and consequences so failed assumptions or contradictions are routed to repair instead of silently corrupting settled state.
type_aType AactorSystem-coined termA Type A is an actor with gated access to the live substrate, able to inspect current files and records, run tools, and perform mutations such as editing, validation, testing, committing, or routing work.
type_a_judgmentType A judgmentactorSystem-coined termType A judgment is a capable substrate actor's governed discernment for noticing what is missing, stale, or misplaced and inferring the right bounded destination from the system's own rules without waiting for a bespoke instruction.
type_a_metabolismType A metabolismruntimeSystem-coined termType A metabolism is the high-agency lane that resolves work with no settled rule—such as naming primitives, repairing contradictions, changing standards, or promoting principles—into governed structure that later routine work can follow.
type_a_operating_registerType A operating registeractorSystem-coined termThe Type A operating register is the expected conduct of a live-substrate agent: steward what it touches and durably route what it learns.
type_bType BactorSystem-coined termA Type B is an actor reasoning from context handed to it outside the live substrate, able to produce advice, drafts, or candidate answers but unable to inspect private files, run local commands, or mutate the system directly.
type_b_metabolismType B metabolismruntimeSystem-coined termType B metabolism is the bounded, deterministic upkeep lane for repeatable work after a structure is settled, such as syncing files, refreshing projections, filling records, and running checks rather than inventing new governing shapes.
typed_relationtyped relationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA typed relation is a recorded link between two statements that says what kind of link it is: that one implies another, reformulates it, is a finite instance of it, or rules out a route to it.
up_propagateup-propagatepropagationSystem-coined termTo up-propagate is to move a reusable local lesson into the smallest durable system artifact that should carry it.
updateupdatepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageAn update is a change that brings material, state, or software to a newer or corrected condition.
validatevalidatepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageTo validate something is to check it against stated requirements or evidence and determine whether those requirements are satisfied.
validationvalidationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageValidation is the act of checking an artifact or result against a declared contract, acceptance condition, or allowed shape and recording the outcome.
validatorvalidatorpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA validator is a program or component that applies declared rules to an input and emits a structured pass, fail, warning, or blocked result.
valuevaluepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA value is the particular data, quantity, text, or status assigned to a variable, field, expression, or measurement.
variablevariablemathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA variable is a named value that may vary or be supplied later; in Plectis it appears both as a mathematical symbol and as a program or configuration value.
verificationverificationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageVerification is the act of confirming that a specific claim, output, or artifact matches its authoritative source or satisfies a precisely stated property.
versionversionpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA version is an identified state of an artifact or system at a particular point in its change history.
vulnerabilityvulnerabilitypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA vulnerability is a weakness that can be exploited or triggered to violate a system's intended security or safety properties.
wavewaveruntimeSystem-local specializationA wave is one bounded pass of execution inside a phase: a single planned unit of work with a stated objective, an execution mode, the paths it is allowed to touch, and a route for folding its outcome back into the system's durable record.
wholewholepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA whole is the complete object, collection, or system considered together rather than only one of its parts.
whole_system_correctnesswhole-system correctnesspublic_projectionSystem-local specializationWhole-system correctness is the claim that an entire system behaves correctly, used here mainly as an explicit boundary that no individual page, component, or passing check is allowed to assert.
workworkpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageWork is purposeful effort that changes, examines, explains, or verifies something.
work_landingwork landingpublic_projectionSystem-coined termWork landing is the transition from attempted activity to a durable accepted result whose changes, validation, ownership, and closeout are recorded.
working_recordworking recordpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA working record is the long-form rendered PDF that preserves the reasoning surface for one Plectis mathematics problem.
workingnessworkingnessdiagnosticSystem-coined termWorkingness is the system's condition of safe, useful self-knowledge—what it believes, why, what remains unknown, what would change its mind, and which actions uncertainty permits—rather than a count of passing tests.
workingness_instrumentWorkingness InstrumentartifactSystem-coined termA workingness instrument is the record that states what one live result proves and which changes that evidence permits or blocks.
zerozeromathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageZero is the number that acts as the additive identity, so adding it leaves a number unchanged.
zonezonepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA zone is one thematic region of the map over the proof corpus, grouping the statements that belong to a single line of argument.
The glossary explains reader-facing words. It does not rename source paths, package ids, old URLs, compatibility handles, or authority records by itself.
